decisions.subject: Named roads: one family reading for the 44 named-road units and their word-for-word twins
decisions.recommendation: Close the named-road family in one pass: (1) front-line wording ("front lot line", "front yard", "fronts on") computes from the lot's primary frontage street through the M-285 join, vocab.named_street line front; (2) side-line wording is not computed: it is UNUSUAL and disclosed (the CHAT-84.NAMED-1b / CHAT-95.X-4 form), because the side street is not held; (3) every unit that computes reads partially_modelled, and its stale "not evaluated" / "not held" status, gaps and description text is corrected by M-75 records; (4) anything that fits none of (1)-(3) is listed for the operator, not changed. Not a new exception (M-336, CHAT-85): it fixes how existing rows read.

decisions.subject: Runner arm: one per-batch transaction carries a step's statements; the derived-row form is allowed on an ENRICHER
decisions.recommendation: New runner arm: ctx.flushBatch([...statements]) runs the listed statements in one transaction per batch, with a SAVEPOINT around each warn_row statement (R-DM), and the R-DY derived-row form is admitted on an ENRICHER, so history rows and alerts commit with the state they describe and a rerun writes zero rows. Today post_commit flushBatch runs one statement per transaction (scripts/lib/step/index.js:5578-5590), and R-DY / R-DM are INGESTOR-only (Spec 132 §ingestor.4). A scripts/lib/step change, so a RE-FREEZE on the bundled runner night with R-JX (CPC-Q1) and R-JY (Q-H4). First user classify_lifecycle_phase.

decisions.subject: classify_lifecycle_phase: START_DATE_URGENT at most once per (user, lead) inside the existing horizon
decisions.recommendation: Option A: START_DATE_URGENT is queued at most once per (user, lead) inside the existing notifications_max_stale_hours horizon (logic variable seeded by migrations/222_notification_gateflip.sql:54, read by scripts/dispatch-notifications.js:71), using a NOT EXISTS on the run clock. Option B (moving the scan after compute_trade_forecasts) is not chosen: it changes who is notified.
